instructions:
1. Delete the debug/verbose/trace lines with one range: :4,6d
2. Move the port line above host: :3m1
3. Between [database] and [cache], change admin to root:
   gg then :/database/,/cache/s/admin/root/g
4. Copy the name line to the end of the file (:t$).
5. Comment out the last three lines: :$-2,$s/^/# /
6. Remove the spaces around = in the whole file (%).

start.main.txt:
# server.conf
host = localhost
port = 8080
debug = true
verbose = true
trace = true
[database]
user = admin
pass = admin
name = app
[cache]
ttl = 60
size = 100

port=8080

[database]

# ttl=60

instructions:
Clean up the log with :g and :v:
1. Delete all blank lines: :g/^$/d
2. Keep only INFO and ERROR lines: :v/INFO\|ERROR/d
3. Move every ERROR line to the end: :g/ERROR/m$
4. Append " !" to every ERROR line: :g/ERROR/norm A !

2. Indent them by two spaces: :2,5norm I  (two spaces)
3. Add a comma to each: :2,5norm A,
4. Sort the ranking numerically. Use a search range:
   :/ranking/+1,$sort n
